{"action":"call_tool","name":"write_file","arguments_json":"{\"relative_path\":\"split.mjs\",\"content\":\"export function allocateShares(totalCents, people) {\\n  if (!Number.isInteger(totalCents) || totalCents < 0) throw new Error('invalid total');\\n  if (!Number.isInteger(people) || people < 1 || people > 1000) throw new Error('invalid people');\\n  const each = Math.floor(totalCents / people);\\n  const remainder = totalCents % people;\\n  return Array.from({ length: people }, (_, index) => each + (index < remainder ? 1 : 0));\\n}\\n\"}","text":null}

{"action":"call_tool","name":"write_file","arguments_json":"{\"relative_path\":\"split.mjs\",\"content\":\"export function allocateShares(totalCents, people) {\\n  if (!Number.isInteger(totalCents) || totalCents < 1) {\\n    throw new Error('Total must be a positive whole number of cents');\\n  }\\n  if (!Number.isInteger(people) || people < 1 || people > 1000) {\\n    throw new Error('People must be a whole number from 1 to 1,000');\\n  }\\n\\n  const each = Math.floor(totalCents / people);\\n  const remainder = totalCents % people;\\n  return Array.from({ length: people }, (_, index) => each + (index < remainder ? 1 : 0));\\n}\\n\"}","text":null}

{"action":"call_tool","name":"write_file","arguments_json":"{\"relative_path\":\"app.mjs\",\"content\":\"import { allocateShares } from './split.mjs';\\n\\nconst form = document.querySelector('#split-form');\\nconst amountInput = document.querySelector('#bill-total');\\nconst peopleInput = document.querySelector('#people-count');\\nconst message = document.querySelector('#form-message');\\nconst results = document.querySelector('#results');\\nconst shareList = document.querySelector('#share-list');\\nconst resultCount = document.querySelector('#result-count');\\nconst resultTotal = document.querySelector('#result-total');\\nconst money = cents => `$${(cents / 100).toFixed(2)}`;\\n\\nfunction clearResults() {\\n  results.classList.remove('visible');\\n  shareList.replaceChildren();\\n  resultCount.textContent = '';\\n  resultTotal.textContent = '';\\n}\\n\\nform.addEventListener('submit', event => {\\n  event.preventDefault();\\n  message.textContent = '';\\n  amountInput.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');\\n  peopleInput.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');\\n  clearResults();\\n\\n  const amountText = amountInput.value.trim();\\n  const amount = Number(amountText);\\n  const totalCents = Math.round(amount * 100);\\n  const people = Number(peopleInput.value);\\n  const amountValid = amountText !== '' && Number.isFinite(amount) && amount > 0 && Math.abs(amount * 100 - totalCents) < 1e-7;\\n  const peopleValid = Number.isInteger(people) && people >= 1 && people <= 1000;\\n\\n  if (!amountValid || !peopleValid) {\\n    if (!amountValid) amountInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');\\n    if (!peopleValid) peopleInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');\\n    message.textContent = [\\n      !amountValid ? 'Enter a bill total greater than $0 with no more than two decimal places.' : '',\\n      !peopleValid ? 'Enter a whole number of people from 1 to 1,000.' : ''\\n    ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');\\n    return;\\n  }\\n\\n  const shares = allocateShares(totalCents, people);\\n  const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();\\n  shares.forEach((share, index) => {\\n    const row = document.createElement('div');\\n    row.className = 'share-row';\\n    const person = document.createElement('span');\\n    person.textContent = `Person ${index + 1}`;\\n    const amount = document.createElement('strong');\\n    amount.textContent = money(share);\\n    row.append(person, amount);\\n    fragment.append(row);\\n  });\\n  shareList.append(fragment);\\n  resultCount.textContent = `${people} ${people === 1 ? 'person' : 'people'}`;\\n  resultTotal.textContent = money(totalCents);\\n  results.classList.add('visible');\\n});\\n\\nform.addEventListener('reset', () => {\\n  message.textContent = '';\\n  amountInput.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');\\n  peopleInput.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');\\n  clearResults();\\n});\\n\"}","text":null}

{"action":"call_tool","name":"write_file","arguments_json":"{\"relative_path\":\"split.test.mjs\",\"content\":\"import test from 'node:test';\\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\\nimport { allocateShares } from './split.mjs';\\n\\ntest('distributes remainder cents to the earliest people', () => {\\n  assert.deepEqual(allocateShares(1001, 3), [334, 334, 333]);\\n});\\n\\ntest('allocates every cent exactly once', () => {\\n  const shares = allocateShares(12345, 17);\\n  assert.equal(shares.reduce((sum, share) => sum + share, 0), 12345);\\n  assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\\n});\\n\\ntest('rejects invalid totals and party counts', () => {\\n  for (const total of [0, -1, 1.5, NaN]) assert.throws(() => allocateShares(total, 2));\\n  for (const people of [0, -1, 1.5, 1001, NaN]) assert.throws(() => allocateShares(100, people));\\n});\\n\"}","text":null}
